payload.build_record:
All four chunks filled by the agent under the recorded delegation, in one pass, sequentially as planned (the build was small enough that fanning out would have cost more than it saved). Verified at run-3a83f64d9dc6: 26/26 GREEN across the new i8d suite AND the shipped i8 lane - no regression. Typecheck clean at run-ac7f984817c4.

c1 THE SEALED BRIEF - engine/brief.ts, new. seal/unseal carrying SP1's proven pair with the layout contract stated once at the top of the file (payload = iv|tag|ct, key = base64url, fragment-only) because getting it wrong fails SILENTLY in a browser while every server-side check passes. briefHtml renders the gate's own text ESCAPED - a brief is ledger prose that may contain markup. briefPage emits one self-contained page: ciphertext in an inert script tag, the opener inline, nothing fetched, dark-mode aware, viewport-metaed for a phone. publishBrief seals, puts with a bounded ttl, then CONFIRMS THE PAGE SERVES before returning a link, and returns null rather than throwing on any failure. KvBriefStore implements the Workers KV calls verified live at run-bfd564ff9add. loadBriefStore reads a machine-local brief.json beside the pairing it serves. Two whitelist guards landed here rather than blacklists: 'servable' is exactly 200-with-text/html, and a store config is loaded only when all four fields are present and well-formed - anything else is no store, which is a legal rung.

c2 THE TAPPABLE CARD - engine/phone.ts, rewritten whole (engine sources take whole-file writes since the live engine hot-reloads them; an incremental patch once left a half-applied module running). answerUrl absolutizes base+topic at SEND time, with the config still holding a bare topic - v1's rule, and its comment names the same trap. The card gains a title naming the iteration and gate, max priority, and a distinct tag, so a gate is not lock-screen noise. The action list is budgeted at three with the third reserved for the brief, because ntfy drops the rest silently. announceOffer now returns a named AnnounceResult instead of void. NtfyTransport publishes the new headers and - a real fix, not a rename - THROWS on a non-2xx, where before a rejected publish was swallowed and reported as success.

c3 PUBLISH IFF THE RUN WAITS - engine/wait.ts, engine/tools.ts, bin/se-board.ts. The park seam fires the summons, guarded by a whitelist: the one announcing state is 'an offer wait beginning while an offer is live'. Every other wait announces nothing - not because it was excluded but because it was never included. se_wait wires the real announcer; the board LOSES its 3-second announce timer and keeps only the tap reader, with the reason written into the file so nobody reattaches it. The comment says plainly why: a poller can see that an offer exists but never whether the run is about to self-bless.

c4 SAY WHAT HAPPENED - engine/phone.ts. Every announce records its outcome through the call log, success AND failure, carrying the topic, iteration, state, brief rung and hash - and never the token. Kept as its own chunk deliberately: recording is the requirement whose absence let the defect survive a day, and folding it into a bigger chunk is how it would quietly go missing again.

COLLATERAL, recorded rather than buried: PhoneLane's constructor now takes a transport FACTORY rather than a prebuilt transport, which is what makes R10 structural instead of aspirational. Six construction sites in the shipped i8 test plus the board were swept mechanically at run-ca88473f3bc3; all seven i8 tests still pass, so the sweep changed shape and not behaviour.

NOT DONE, and named: the demonstration D1 needs the store's own machine-local config written on this machine before the final gate parks. That is setup, not build, and it happens before the release gate.
